- When sentiment is positive (≥ 0.3), model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 1–2% for next period.  
- After a sharp price spike (forecast > 75), model often overshoots; cap forecast at +5% above peak or adjust downward by 3–5% in next 3–5 days.  
- If sentiment is negative (≤ -0.3) and price is falling, model underestimates; add 1–2% to forecast to avoid premature bottoming.  
- Model consistently underestimates in early 30-day horizon (first 5–7 days); apply +1–3% bias to first 5 days if sentiment is neutral or slightly positive.  
- Mean reversion is strong in 10–15 day window; if forecast deviates > 3% from 10-day moving average, adjust toward it.  
- If sentiment is volatile (rapid swings), model overfits short-term noise; smooth forecast by averaging last 3–5 days’ values.
